messages:
Elena: Hi all  first-week q: where's the canonical spot to post onboarding questions vs product questions? Also how strict are we about using threads?

Marco (it): Hey Elena! Access/credentials and hardware requests -> #help. Product/feature questions -> product or the specific feature channel. Threads are preferred for follow-ups so channels stay scannable.

Zoe (devex): Short addition: put short subjects in the first message like `[Access]` or `[CI]`. Use reactions for ack/noise. If you want mentors to see something, ping them in the thread, don't @channel.

Elena: Got it. I also triggered the onboarding checklist but it shows a missing SSH key. Is it ok to post the public key here?

Onboard-Bot: @Elena Do not post private keys. Paste only the public key into the #help ticket or the onboarding form. Commands: `/onboard status`, `/onboard help`.

Marco (it): Exact: open #help, create ticket with subject `SSH key - <your-name>`, attach the public key and your machine type. We'll provision. If you need VPN immediately, add `vpn: urgent` in the ticket.

Elena: Thanks. Quick etiquette Q: when do we use bots vs manual tickets?

Zoe (devex): Bots automate common flows (deploy, onboarding, device requests). Use the bot commands in-channel when available; otherwise file a ticket in #help and mention the bot if the flow supports it. Example: `/device-request vpn` triggers IT-Bot and creates HELP ticket.

IT-Bot: To request VPN token run: `/device-request --type vpn --user elena`. Or mention `@it create vpn` in #help.

Elena: Perfect. Last thing: where do I post a longer intro so people can welcome me?

Zoe (devex): Put a short intro in #general and paste a longer note (hobbies, previous role, timezone) in #new-hires. Folks often add a :wave: reaction and brief welcomes in thread.

Elena: Awesome, thanks everyone! Opening the #help ticket now and will re-run `/onboard status`. :)
